498A False Case Remedy – Know Your Legal Rights

If you believe you have been falsely implicated in a matrimonial cruelty case, understanding your legal options is essential.

✔ Stay calm
 ✔ Preserve evidence
 ✔ Respond to legal notices properly
 ✔ Seek timely legal advice
 ✔ Understand your rights regarding bail and court proceedings

Every case is different, and the outcome depends on the facts, evidence, and applicable law.
